newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures end easier, near lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures end easier, near lows.

text.p: White sugar futures slipped to session lows during late Wednesday LIFFE trading, and finished with losses across the board.
Traders said the market was unable to sustain a mid-afternoon mini-bounce, and subsequently reverted to the downside.

The soggy trend reflected the large deliveries that took place in London against the expiring May futures. There was a hefty physical delivery of nearly 90,000 tonnes of sugar from British, Dutch, German and Spanish ports. The two receivers were Prudential Bache and Sucre Export.
